records.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
records.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.

records.title: Comex Gold, Silver Settle Lower
records.summary: Gold settled 1.4% lower, down two of the past three sessions, and silver fell 2.5%, down three of the past four sessions.

records.title: DeepSeek Won't Sink U.S. AI Titans
records.summary: Panic fueling the selloff of Nvidia, Broadcom and other tech giants is overblown.

records.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
records.summary: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

records.title: Arabica Coffee Prices Hit Record on U.S., Colombia Tariff Spat
records.summary: Arabica coffee prices hit a record level, as traders digested the withdrawal of President Trump’s threats to impose tariffs and economic sanctions on Colombia.
